nodes.rationale: Policy rules currently match command text; argv-level execution would let rules match commands exactly.

nodes.label: Live Runs on OpenRouter (2026-10-08)
nodes.rationale: Lesson: a cheaper model (Muse Spark 1.3) reaches the goal but leans on guardrails (skills, early-stop nudge, stall detection); Opus 5.5 needed none. Bugs found live (sequential subagents, stall hang, leaked web server, early stop) each produced a fix.

nodes.label: Sandbox Option for Unattended auto Mode (planned)
nodes.norm_label: sandbox option for unattended auto mode (planned)

nodes.label: TESTED / LIVE / UNTESTED Status Labels
nodes.rationale: Offline tests use a scripted fake model, so they prove runtime mechanics but not model judgement; LIVE marks behaviour seen against a real OpenRouter model.

nodes.label: ACP Wire Messages (initialize, session/new, session/prompt, session/update)
nodes.norm_label: acp wire messages (initialize, session/new, session/prompt, session/update)

nodes.label: Agent Client Protocol (ACP)
nodes.rationale: Newline-delimited JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio; same protocol Zed uses with Claude Code, Gemini CLI and Hermes, so the agent layer is reusable by any ACP client.

nodes.label: bash 3.2-safe Shell Marker Protocol
nodes.rationale: Agent always uses bash even for zsh users for predictable output; macOS ships bash 3.2.

nodes.label: Claude Agent SDK / Claude Code (influence)
nodes.rationale: Borrowed tool semantics, permission modes, hooks contract, sessions, subagents, skills; the SDK itself was left out because it drives the Claude Code CLI and is Anthropic-only, while OpenRouter was needed.

nodes.norm_label: before the first real run checklist

nodes.label: OpenClaw (influence)
nodes.rationale: Gateway-to-native-app split is the model for the Reflick architecture.

nodes.label: session/request_permission Approval Flow
nodes.rationale: allow_all is only offered when safe to grant; parallel subagents may have several requests open, titled with [name].

nodes.label: Per-request Cost Budget and Loop Guards
nodes.norm_label: per-request cost budget and loop guards

nodes.label: Process Containment (env-tagged background jobs killed with shell)
nodes.norm_label: process containment (env-tagged background jobs killed with shell)

nodes.label: registry.py (validate-policy-hooks-approve-run-ledger path)
nodes.rationale: Single path for every tool call so policy, hooks, approval and auditing cannot be bypassed.

nodes.label: Secret Env Scrubbing (clean_env)
nodes.rationale: API key is held in memory only; the agent's own shell never sees it (closed a P0 key-leak gap).

nodes.label: Stalled-response Detection (stall_seconds)
nodes.rationale: OpenRouter keep-alives otherwise hide a dead stream; added after a real 8-minute hang.

nodes.label: subagents.py (delegate / subagents)
nodes.rationale: Children cannot delegate further, ask the user, write memory or edit to-dos; research subagents only take no-approval actions unless can_change.

nodes.label: Handoff: Unified Agent Layer for Reflick
nodes.norm_label: handoff: unified agent layer for reflick

nodes.label: Reflick Integration via ACP Child Process
nodes.norm_label: reflick integration via acp child process
nodes.rationale: Instead of porting designs to Swift, Reflick spawns agent.py --acp so loop, tools, policy, ledger, skills and subagents stay in one tested place. Earlier notes on Reflick's codebase (ToolRegistry, no CentralPolicyEngine) remain unverified.

nodes.label: App Store Sandbox Constraint / Packaging
nodes.rationale: A child process inherits the App Store sandbox and can't reach most of the disk; ship via Developer ID + notarization or a separately signed helper; venv first, PyInstaller/briefcase later.

nodes.label: macOS sudo Handling in ACP Mode
nodes.norm_label: macos sudo handling in acp mode
nodes.rationale: No terminal in ACP mode so sudo cannot prompt. Options best-first: leave root work to user; osascript with administrator privileges after approval card; SMAppService privileged helper. Never pass the password through the agent.
